subject: Role mapping, SCIM sync window & IP allowlist choreography
messages:
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: kevin.smythe@trustbank.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Role mapping, SCIM sync window & IP allowlist choreography

Hi Kevin —

Thanks again for the call earlier. To summarize next steps from Redwood for the initial production cutover:

- We'll need the SCIM provisioning window (30–60 minutes) where TrustBank can accept the first delta of users/groups.
- We propose role mapping rules scoped to three RBAC groups you outlined (Admins, App Editors, Readonly). I've attached a CSV with the proposed mapping.
- Network: please confirm the public egress CIDRs for your NAT gateways so we can update the IP allowlist. I attached the CIDR list we currently have on file — please correct any entries.

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm a preferred 30-minute window between Mon 4/1 and Wed 4/3 (window start time in UTC).
2) Validate the role-mapping CSV and flag any custom attributes we should consider for SCIM (e.g., department, employeeType).
3) Give a single point-of-contact for on-call during the cutover (name + mobile).

From our side: Monica will own the cutover runbook and on-call, Ben will coordinate commercial/uptime SLAs, and Jonas will handle IP/networking validation with your infra team.

Attached: trustbank_role_mapping_v1.csv, scim-sync-window-proposal.pdf, ip-allowlist-cidr-ranges.txt

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0132
From: kevin.smythe@trustbank.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.gupta@trustbank.com, michael.lee@trustbank.com, procurement@trustbank.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 12:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role mapping, SCIM sync window & IP allowlist choreography

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers below:

1) Sync window: We can do Tue 4/2 16:00–16:30 PDT (23:00–23:30 UTC). That is our scheduled maintenance window for identity provisioning.
2) Role CSV: Sara will review the mapping for Admin vs Editor scoping; expect comments by EOD Mon 4/1.
3) On-call: Michael Lee (m: +1 602 555 0199) will be on call during the window; Sara will be backup.

CIDRs: I fixed an internal NAT range in ip-allowlist-cidr-ranges.txt (line 4) — see inline comments. Procurement looped in for the standard PO and SLA amendment.

Couple of notes from security: we must not provision any accounts that have the attribute employeeType=contractor without an explicit owner approval; Sara will send a list of contractors to exclude. Also, we need audit logs for SCIM events forwarded to our SIEM (logstash endpoint) for 90 days as part of the compliance checklist.

Thanks,
Kevin
IT Operations, TrustBank
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: kevin.smythe@trustbank.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role mapping, SCIM sync window & IP allowlist choreography

Kevin — perfect, thanks for confirming the window. A few quick clarifications and mitigations for Sara's contractor rule and the SIEM requirement:

- SCIM filtering: we can apply a pre-sync filter so any user with employeeType=contractor is excluded from the provisioning delta. Please confirm the exact attribute name TrustBank uses (employeeType vs contractType vs emp_type).
- Audit logs: Redwood can push SCIM and admin audit events to a customer-managed syslog/HTTP endpoint. We'll need the log endpoint URL and an ingestion contact. We retain logs for 30 days by default — we can extend to 90 days with the audit-retention addendum (Ben will outline cost/contract change).
- Role mapping: Monica, can you add a small step in the runbook to snapshot the existing RBAC assignments in TrustBank's app prior to the sync (in case rollback required)?

Monica: once Sara returns the role CSV we will generate a dry-run SCIM delta and share a preview report for Michael to sign off before the live window.

Next: I'll update the Drive doc and attach the proposed dry-run report template.

—Marissa
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: procurement@trustbank.com, kevin.smythe@trustbank.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role mapping, SCIM sync window & IP allowlist choreography

Hi Procurement team —

Looping in per Kevin's note. Two commercial items to confirm before the cutover:

1) Audit log retention to 90 days is an add-on; estimated recurring cost: $1,200 / month. I can share the contract amendment and a redline to the Master Services Agreement.
2) Temporary SLA uplift for the first 30 days post-cutover (to cover initial instability): we can put a 99.9% availability target for the provisioned tenant during this window. If you want this, let me know and I will send a formal quote.

If procurement needs a PO number to speed sign-off, please provide it and I'll get finance to raise the amendment.

Thanks — Ben
Director, Solutions Sales
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: kevin.smythe@trustbank.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, michael.lee@trustbank.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role mapping, SCIM sync window & IP allowlist choreography

Kevin / Michael / Sara —

Thanks for confirming the window (Tue 4/2 16:00 PDT). Per the runbook checklist I've attached:
- 15:20 PDT: pre-sync checklist (snapshot RBAC, export existing users).
- 16:00 PDT: SCIM dry-run enabled (no write) — Redwood will produce a delta preview and send to Michael for sign-off within 5 minutes.
- 16:10 PDT: on approval, enable live sync for 30 minutes. We will watch provisioning, monitor for provisioning errors, and validate audit events are being sent to your SIEM endpoint.
- 16:40 PDT: post-sync validation (sample user logins, RBAC smoke tests).
- 17:00 PDT: rollback window until 18:00 PDT if we see critical issues.

Action items for TrustBank before EOD Mon 4/1:
- Sara to send the final role mapping CSV and contractor exclusion attribute name.
- Michael to confirm SIEM ingestion endpoint URL and contact.
- Kevin to confirm that the CIDRs in ip-allowlist-cidr-ranges.txt are final.

I'll be on the call and will run the timeline; Michael, please confirm you'll be available and share your mobile if there are any issues.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
